technologies.notes: service database is strong for non-HTTP: OpenSSH 8.9p1 Ubuntu 3ubuntu0.6, Redis 7.4.12, nginx 1.27.5 with CPE; web application layer only as raw header/title text

projectdiscovery.stage1_command: naabu -host 172.31.0.0/24 -exclude-hosts 172.31.0.1,172.31.0.2,172.31.0.3 -p 22,80,443,6379,8000,8080,8081 -rate 300 -silent -json -o naabu.jsonl | httpx -l hostports.txt -rl 50 -silent -sc -title -td -server -location -fr -favicon -tls-grab -irh -json -o httpx.jsonl | nuclei -l urls.txt -tags tech,panel -rl 50 -silent -nc -jsonl -o nuclei.jsonl
projectdiscovery.timings_note: nuclei ran with -rl 50 in stage 1 and -rl 150 in stages 2 and 3
projectdiscovery.service_names: naabu reports ports only; httpx identifies HTTP vs HTTPS correctly on all web ports; ssh and redis get no service name

reported.notes: certificate SHA-256 equals the ground truth; -favicon was set but no hash came back for the lab's 26-byte placeholder favicon (httpx normally emits an mmh3 hash)

technologies.notes: httpx: WordPress:6.4.2, Drupal:10, PHP:7.4.3, Nginx:1.27.5 (plus implied MySQL/PHP for WordPress and Drupal). nuclei: wordpress-login (/wp-login.php), wordpress-eol 6.4.2, wordpress-theme-detect, drupal-detect, drupal-login, php-detect 7.4.3, php-eol, nginx-version, nginx-eol. The custom admin panel, the staging marker and the NETCAM camera match no stock template.
technologies.false_positives: nuclei waf-detect:nginxgeneric on every HTTP endpoint (10 in stage 1); there is no WAF
